floater.name: fs_ai_writer
floater.title: AI Chat Assistant Settings
floater.floater.string: Asking the server for its models...
floater.text: AI features (all off by default; set up the server below first):

check_box.label: Writing suggestions in the chat bar (language and style boxes)
check_box.name: feature_suggestions_check

line_editor.tool_tip: OpenAI-compatible chat completions URL. llama.cpp (llama-server): http://SERVER-IP:8080/v1/chat/completions - LM Studio: http://localhost:1234/v1/chat/completions - Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions
line_editor.name: endpoint_editor

combo_box.tool_tip: Model name on the server. Leave empty to use the server default (llama.cpp and LM Studio use the loaded model).
combo_box.name: model_combo

button.label: Load models
button.tool_tip: Ask the server which models it offers
button.name: fetch_models_btn

check_box.label: Skip model reasoning (Gemma 4, Qwen3, ...)
check_box.tool_tip: Needed for reasoning models such as Gemma 4 or Qwen3 on llama.cpp: otherwise they spend the whole answer thinking
check_box.name: disable_thinking_check

check_box.label: Auto-translate incoming messages in other languages
check_box.tool_tip: Every chat or IM message from a person that is not already in the translation language gets a translation line right below it
check_box.name: auto_translate_check

check_box.label: Show 'Translate message (AI)' when right-clicking a message
check_box.name: translate_menu_check

combo_box.tool_tip: Language translations are written in (you can also type another one, in English)
combo_box.name: translate_to_combo

check_box.label: ChatBot: allow internet access (web search)
check_box.tool_tip: The question is searched on the web (FSAIChatbotSearchURL, DuckDuckGo by default) and the results are given to the AI, which cites them
check_box.name: chatbot_websearch_check

check_box.label: ChatBot: show web sources below answers
check_box.tool_tip: List the web pages the answer was based on (only when internet access is on)
check_box.name: chatbot_sources_check

check_box.label: ChatBot: knows your surroundings and avatar profiles
check_box.tool_tip: Region, nearby avatars and online friends are given to the AI; when a question mentions a nearby avatar or friend, their profile is looked up. Respects RLV name restrictions.
check_box.name: chatbot_slcontext_check

button.label: Test connection
button.tool_tip: Send a short test translation to the server
button.name: test_btn
